title: The piling
logline: The bird on a dock piling in fog. Wrong for the coast, every color, not explained. The dock, the fog, the bird. It stays.

panels.composition: Fog on the bay, the dock dissolving into it. One piling in the foreground, barnacled, and on it the small rainbow bird — every color, sharp in a page where nothing else is — looking out at the water. No people. Gully's shack a gray shape. The fog takes the rest.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a barnacled dock piling in thick fog with a small brilliantly rainbow-colored bird perched on top looking out at the water, the dock and a shingle shack dissolving into gray behind, no people, no words
image.notes: The bird is the only saturated color on the page.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The bird, second sighting. The piling. Not explained.
